apps.name: KMusic
apps.subtitle: 基于 SwiftUI 的多源音乐聚合播放器
apps.localizedDescription: 基于 SwiftUI 开发的多源音乐聚合播放器，支持 iOS/macOS。内置酷我、酷狗、QQ 音乐、网易云、咪咕等多平台音源，支持 LRC 歌词同步、全局搜索、后台播放与深色主题，并可通过 JS 脚本导入自定义音源。

apps.name: Kumone
apps.subtitle: 原生 NetEase Cloud Music iOS 客户端（雲の音）
apps.localizedDescription:
Kumone（雲の音）— native NetEase Cloud Music client for iOS. Talks directly to NetEase's real API with no third-party server: QR-code login, gray-track unblocking, synced lyrics with translation, immersive artwork-tinted now-playing, and playlist management.

Supports English and Simplified Chinese localization.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Added / 新增

- **iOS + macOS**: a sleep timer — stop playback after a set duration or at the end of the current track, from the 播放 menu (macOS) or the now-playing more-actions menu (iOS). Thanks @yamakze (#98, closes #96).
- **iOS + macOS**：新增睡眠定时——可在设定时长后、或当前歌曲播完后停止播放,入口在「播放」菜单(macOS)或播放页的更多菜单(iOS)。感谢 @yamakze（#98，关闭 #96）。
- **iOS + macOS**: jump from a playing track to its artist or album page (and play from there) via the artwork / track menu. Thanks @yamakze (#95, closes #80).
- **iOS + macOS**：可从正在播放的歌曲跳转到其歌手或专辑页并从那里播放(通过封面 / 歌曲菜单)。感谢 @yamakze（#95，关闭 #80）。
- **macOS**: an ambient background behind the main window derived from the current track's artwork — a soft color wash plus a subtle titlebar tint that follows the playing song. On by default; toggle it off or adjust the intensity in Settings. Thanks @yamakze (#86).
- **macOS**：主窗口新增取自当前封面的氛围背景——柔和的色彩铺底 + 淡淡的标题栏染色，随播放歌曲变化。默认开启,可在设置里关闭或调节强度。感谢 @yamakze（#86）。
- **iOS**: the artwork ambient background is now available on iOS too, with the same toggle + intensity slider in Settings. Thanks @yamakze (#99).
- **iOS**：封面氛围背景现在 iOS 也支持,设置里同样有开关与强度滑块。感谢 @yamakze（#99）。

### Fixed / 修复

- **macOS**: the now-playing artwork no longer snaps out of place during the open/close transition when the image finishes loading mid-animation. Thanks @Perfect9s (#92).
- **macOS**：进入 / 退出播放页时,封面即使在动画途中才加载完也不再错位跳动。感谢 @Perfect9s（#92）。
- **macOS**: the main-window titlebar ambient tint now matches the app's light/dark appearance instead of lagging a step behind it. Thanks @yamakze (#93).
- **macOS**：主窗口标题栏的氛围染色现在会正确匹配 App 的浅色 / 深色外观,不再慢一拍。感谢 @yamakze（#93）。
- **macOS**: switching a fixed theme (Light/Dark) back to "follow system" now updates the native titlebars of both the main and Settings windows immediately, via `NSApp.appearance`. (#94)
- **macOS**：把固定主题(浅色 / 深色)切回「跟随系统」时,主窗口与设置窗口的原生标题栏现在会通过 `NSApp.appearance` 立即同步。（#94）

- **macOS**: the toolbar search field and the floating player bar now keep more clearance from the window's rounded corners, so their capsules no longer nearly touch the window edges and the inner/outer corner radii stop visually merging. (#88)
- **macOS**：工具栏搜索框与悬浮播放条现在与窗口圆角保持更多间距,不再几乎贴住窗口边缘,内外圆角也不再互相干扰。（#88）
- **macOS**: the album artwork in the player bar and the immersive now-playing page no longer shows a stray blue focus ring (macOS 27 drew the system focus ring on those decorative artwork buttons). (#97)
- **macOS**：播放条与沉浸播放页的专辑封面不再出现多余的蓝色聚焦边框（macOS 27 会在这些装饰性封面按钮上绘制系统聚焦环）。（#97）

apps.name: Opaline
apps.subtitle: YouTube client for iOS 12+
apps.localizedDescription: A lightweight, privacy-focused YouTube client for iOS, built with UIKit. SponsorBlock, Return YouTube Dislike, up to 1080p playback, background audio, Picture-in-Picture, subtitles and offline downloads — no ads, no tracking, no dependencies.

versions.localizedDescription:
**New**

- Hold anywhere on the video to seek ([#116](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/116)). Press and hold on the picture, then drag sideways. The seek bar follows your finger and the video jumps where you let go, so you no longer have to hit the thin bar at the bottom. The taps you already know still work: the sides seek, the middle pauses.
- Search inside a channel ([#117](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/117)). Channel pages have a magnifier now, and whatever you type there searches that channel only. YouTube serves no filters for this kind of search, so there are none in the app either.
- Get a downloaded video out of the app ([#115](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/115)). The menu on a downloaded video has a new "Save to Files" row that hands the file to the usual iOS share sheet, so it can go to Files, Photos, AirDrop or another app. It is named after the video, and only the video leaves: subtitles, comments and the saved page stay where they were.
- Clear the whole search history at once ([#121](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/121)). The last row under Recent searches wipes the list, and it asks first.

**Fixes**

- The mini player no longer sits on top of the tab bar ([#118](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/118)). Tapping a tab behind the collapsed player switches to that tab instead of reopening the video.
- Stereo no longer gets spatialized on AirPods ([#119](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/119)). Ordinary two-channel sound was being turned into a fake surround field that moved when you turned your head. Video that really is multichannel still spatializes.
- The "..." menu stops closing on its own ([#128](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/128)). It was reacting to the device being tilted or put down, which made it look random when you held the phone in your hand.

**Also**

- If your device is older than Opaline supports, the README now points at [a downport for iOS 9](https://github.com/Joeviocoe/Opaline) by another developer, which runs on the iPad 2, iPad 3, iPad mini and iPhone 4S ([#125](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/125)).

apps.name: Pocket Poster
apps.subtitle: Custom PosterBoard animated wallpapers for iOS 17.0+
apps.localizedDescription: Custom PosterBoard animated wallpapers for iOS 17.0+. Browse community wallpapers in the built-in explore page, import your own videos and images, and apply them as animated posters — including CarPlay and per-collection sets.

versions.localizedDescription:
# Features
- Added an in-app explore page for finding and downloading wallpapers
- Added custom CarPlay wallpapers (will not work on iOS 26.0)
- *Preliminary* iOS 16 support (not all wallpapers will work)
- Improved certain error messages

# Bug Fixes
- Fixed the aspect ratio/rotation of imported custom videos
- Fixed the update API not being called correctly
- Fixed issues with some alerts not popping up
- Other various app stability improvements
